task.description: Implement REQ-519 PR 2f-a. Mandatory SEC: scope_enforcement.ex, scope_enforcement/on_gate.ex, audit.ex, routers/tenant_scope_enforcement.ex (integrity), identity/sync_scope_guard.ex.

result.summary: OnGate.evaluate/3 (six facts, all evaluated, read order fixed), ScopedApprovers.count/1 (AC-literal, active only), ShadowWindow (T0 from audit chain, one grouped counts_by_day query, thresholds from env with default fallback, configuration criterion, evidence_scope/scope_sentence, flush_evidence/0), ShadowEvidence.counts_by_day/3 and reasons/0, Audit.latest_matching/4 (SyncScopeGuard dedup swapped to it, behaviour identical), RefusedAudit.record/6 (best-effort, own transaction, constant log line), Identity.count_interactive_explicit_tenant_wide_admins/1 (C-4), integrity on_gate block (lock-free snapshot, no audit), attrs[:now] seam, flip/4 dormant shadow->on path (flush before transaction, gate inside the one rescue, refusal audit after rollback, shadow_required for off->on), router 500 path logs ONE constant line scope_enforcement_flip_failed. on stays UNSETTABLE: parse_mode/1, @modes and check_target/1 untouched.

existing_tests_edited_forced: test/letflow/scope_enforcement_test.exs (T-I1 clean tenant: integrity map gains on_gate)

deviations: The shadow->on path in flip/4 and do_flip is DORMANT: check_target/1 still rejects :on, so no internal caller can reach it through flip/4 in this PR; the gate is exercised by calling OnGate.evaluate/3, ShadowWindow, RefusedAudit directly. The path becomes live when 2f-b widens @modes/parse_mode. check_reason got target in [:shadow, :on] (guard form) because the compiler type check (warnings-as-errors) flags a literal :on clause or a target == :on comparison as unreachable; flush_before?/1 is a one-line helper for the same reason.

Audit action rule left as 'target in [:shadow, :on] is enabled' (not the rank rule); on -> shadow still runs enable_checks! (stage-1 behaviour). The rank rule and the NO-precondition de-escalation are 2f-b (T-X7, T-X10).

The router 500 clause logs the constant line (reason tag, exception module or none) for every non-mapped error; the 409 mapping of {:on_precondition_failed,...} / :shadow_required is 2f-b (currently unreachable).
integrity/1 now raises (MatchError) for a prefix that is not a tenant_<32 hex> schema name (it derives the tenant id for T0); previously it never raised. Real callers always pass a tenant schema.
Threshold defaults live only in ShadowWindow module attributes (config.exs NOT modified after rework); config files untouched.
on_gate integrity body also carries an evidence sub-block (window dates, shadow_since, counts, criteria booleans, evidence_scope); no ids.
Extra public accessors beyond the design: ShadowWindow.blocking_reasons/0, reported_reasons/0, flush_evidence/0; OnGate.audit_state/1 (shared serialisation of the audit payload).
started_at is approximate (the session did not record its start clock); completed_at is real UTC.
The mixlock dir was absent for every mix run (I created it for the run and removed it after). At the end rmdir failed because another session had written an owner file into it; I left it untouched.
